This weekend is stacked with live music from 40+ local acts across three stages, an artists market with incredible vendors, and some very special surprises after midnight.<br>Friday's music runs from 6:00 PM to midnight. Saturday kicks off at 2 PM and goes late. Just good people and nonstop music in the middle of Houston. The festival is all ages (anyone under 18 MUST have an adult present) and everyone under 21 will be allowed  until the last band ends at Midnight.<br>Located at Axelrad Beer Garden, Solar Flare is more than a festival, it’s a love letter to the artists who make this city special.
